name: Rothwell
address: Cnr Mewes Rd & Anzac Ave, Rothwell
intro: Whether church is familiar or brand new to you, there's a seat saved for you. Come as you are.
ticker: Free barista coffee for first timers

steps.title: Arrive
steps.text: Aim for about 10 minutes early. Park free beside the Chapel and look for our welcome team at the door.

steps.title: If you have kids
steps.text: Our Next Gen team will get your children checked in and settled, then show you where to pick them up.

steps.title: Gather
steps.text: We sing, pray and hear a message from the Bible. The whole service runs for about 65 minutes.

steps.title: Stay for a coffee
steps.text: If it's your first time, your barista coffee is on us. It's the easiest way to meet a few people.

welcome.quote: "You don't need to know the songs, own a Bible or have it all worked out. Just come. We'd love to meet you."
welcome.text: Walking into a church for the first time can feel like a big step. I get that. Every week we have people with us who are just checking things out, people coming back after a long break, and people who've followed Jesus for decades.

points: Runs at the 8.30am and 10am services during school terms
In school holidays kids join their families in the service
No kids program at 5pm, so kids stay with you
Every leader holds a Blue Card and completes child-safe training

practical.title: Accessible site
practical.text: Our site is accessible, with disability parking available.

practical.title: Parents' room
practical.text: A quiet space if you need it with your little one.

practical.title: No dress code
practical.text: Wear whatever you're comfortable in. Most people dress like they're heading to the shops.

faqExtra.a: They're very similar, with the same message and music. The main difference is that kids programs only run in the morning.

faqExtra.q: How do I find the building?
faqExtra.a: We meet in the Chapel at Grace Lutheran College, Rothwell. Turn off Anzac Ave into Mewes Rd. The Chapel is the large building first on your left, so turn into the first carpark and you'll see it. There are signs on Sundays too.

kidsFaq: At the 8.30am and 10am services we run Tots, Kids Crew Jnr and Kids Crew during school terms. In school holidays kids join their families in the service.

name: Caboolture West
intro: A new Lifepoint church for Caboolture West and the growing Waraba community. Come as you are.

steps.title: Arrive
steps.text: Aim for about 10 minutes early. Look for the Lifepoint signs and our welcome team at the door.

steps.title: If you have kids
steps.text: Our Lifepoint Kids team will get your children checked in and settled, then show you where to pick them up.

steps.title: Gather
steps.text: We sing, pray and hear a message from the Bible. The whole service runs for about 65 minutes.

steps.title: Stay for a coffee
steps.text: Stick around after the service for a coffee. It's the easiest way to meet a few people.

welcome.quote: "We'd love to meet you. Come as you are and bring your questions."
welcome.text: Georgie and I live in the area, and we love this community. Thousands of families are moving into Caboolture West, and most arrive not knowing anyone. We want Lifepoint to be a place where you find friendship, hope and a real relationship with Jesus.

points: Lifepoint Kids runs during the 9.30am service
Every leader holds a Blue Card and completes child-safe training
Pre-register online to skip the forms on the day

practical.title: Parking
practical.text: Park at the college and follow the Lifepoint signs.

practical.title: Kids welcome
practical.text: Lifepoint Kids runs during the service, and little ones are always welcome in the room.

practical.title: No dress code
practical.text: Wear whatever you're comfortable in. Most people dress like they're heading to the shops.

practical.title: New and growing
practical.text: We're a brand new church, so you're joining us near the start.

faqExtra.a: Our first service is Sunday 7 February 2027, and we meet every Sunday at 9.30am from then on.

faqExtra.q: How do I find the building?
faqExtra.a: We meet at Grace Lutheran College, Caboolture Campus, 129 Toohey St, Caboolture. Look for the Lifepoint signs on Sunday mornings.

kidsFaq: Lifepoint Kids runs during the 9.30am service.
